question: What is the primary goal of segregating medical waste at the point of generation?

options.A: To prevent the spread of nosocomial infections
options.B: To reduce overall hospital electricity consumption
options.C: To make waste collection faster for administrative staff
options.D: To lower the financial cost of purchasing drugs

explanation: Separating infectious waste immediately protects patients, healthcare workers, and the community from hospital-acquired pathogens. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h1)

question: A nurse throws blood-soaked cotton swabs into a regular paper bin. What rule was broken?

options.A: Immediate waste segregation at the point of generation
options.B: Proper documentation of fluid intake and output
options.C: Aseptic technique during wound dressing changes

explanation: You've got this! Contaminated items must be sorted into the right containers right where you use them to stop germs from spreading. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h1)

question: An unused, expired bottle of paracetamol syrup belongs to which type of medical waste?
explanation: Any expired or unused medications, syrups, and vaccines fall straight under pharmaceutical waste. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h2)

question: Human tissue specimens and body parts removed during surgery are classified as what type of waste?
explanation: Human tissues and body parts need special handling as pathological waste because they are biological materials. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h2)

question: According to standard hospital guidelines in Nigeria, what color is typically used for general domestic waste bins?
explanation: Black bins are meant for everyday non-hazardous trash that doesn't carry any infection risk. Easy to remember! [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h3)

question: After giving an injection in the ward, where should the used needle go immediately?

options.A: An open stainless steel kidney dish
options.B: A red plastic bag for general plastics

explanation: Always drop needles straight into a yellow sharps box to keep everyone safe from accidental pricks. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h3)

question: What is placed inside secondary packaging when transporting lab specimens to soak up accidental leaks?
explanation: Good padding with absorbent material ensures that if the main bottle breaks, no fluid spills out. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h4)

question: Why should a laboratory request form never be wrapped directly around a liquid specimen bottle?

options.A: It slows down the processing time at the reception desk
options.B: It risks contamination of the paperwork if the bottle leaks
options.C: It makes the outer package too heavy to carry easily
options.D: It causes the laboratory refrigerator temperature to drop

explanation: Keeping paperwork separate from the specimen protects patient data and keeps the request form readable if a spill happens. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h4)

question: What does an autoclave mainly use to sterilize medical instruments and lab waste?
explanation: Autoclaves use high heat and pressurized steam to completely wipe out stubborn germs. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h5)

question: Why is incineration preferred over ordinary dumping for human body parts and pathological waste?

options.A: It produces fertilizer for agricultural farming use
options.B: It is the cheapest method of municipal waste collection
options.C: It allows the hospital to recycle metal components easily
options.D: It ensures complete destruction and prevents public health hazards

explanation: Incineration reduces anatomical waste completely to ash, safely removing any biological hazards. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h5)

question: What is the first thing a nurse should do after accidentally getting a needle-stick injury?

options.A: Cover the puncture wound tightly with an adhesive plaster
options.B: Apply a tight tourniquet above the elbow to trap the virus
options.C: Scrub the bleeding wound vigorously with an iodine swab
options.D: Wash the site thoroughly with soap and running water

explanation: Don't panic! Washing the spot immediately with soap and water safely reduces the germ load without harming the skin. [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h6)

question: Why should you avoid vigorous scrubbing when managing a fresh needle-stick injury?

options.A: It can cause micro-abrasions that help germs enter the bloodstream
options.B: It neutralizes the action of post-exposure prophylactic medications
options.C: It prevents the proper clotting of blood at the injury site
options.D: It permanently stains the skin surface around the puncture wound

explanation: Scrubbing too hard damages delicate skin layers further, which can actually push germs deeper inside. Gentle washing is best! [learn more](GST114_U2_T14#GST114_U2_T14_h6)
